text.en:
Germany to Turkey Shipping — Hanbros UK

Hanbros UK extends Germany-to-Turkey logistics via our European hub, connecting German collections with UK export expertise and Turkish delivery.

Our operations span Berlin, Munich, Hamburg, Frankfurt, Cologne and nationwide. German-origin goods are consolidated through our UK corridor for efficient, customs-compliant transit to Turkey.

Services from Germany to Turkey

  • International cargo & parcels to all Turkish cities.
  • Household removals with professional packing and customs.
  • Vehicle shipping with full export/import documentation.
  • Commercial freight for businesses and traders.
  • Express & economy options to match your budget and timeline.

Hanbros UK advantage: Whether your goods originate in Germany or the UK, you receive one dedicated coordinator, one transparent quote and one trusted brand on the Europe–Turkey corridor.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you collect in Germany?

Yes — we arrange collections across Berlin, Munich, Hamburg, Frankfurt, Cologne and nationwide and coordinate transit to Turkey via our UK hub and direct routes.

How long does shipping from Germany to Turkey take?

Typically 7–21 days depending on service level, route and customs — we confirm at quote stage.

Is customs included?

Export and import customs brokerage is handled by our experienced team on both sides.

Hanbros UK — your partner for Germany to Turkey logistics.
